rule.data: E4 CAL_ROUTER LLM responses (v2 Gemini run), EXCLUDING the P-49 list below
rule.specialist_probability: 5-fold out-of-fold isotonic calibration within CAL_ROUTER, per corpus, StratifiedKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42), fit on specialist_prob_uncal
rule.score: binary entropy (bits) of the OOF calibrated probability
rule.objective: maximise B(tau) - C(tau) over candidate taus = distinct OOF scores; escalate iff score > tau; LLM failure => keep specialist decision
rule.uncertainty: 2,000 bootstrap resamples of E4 URLs, seed 42 -> 95% percentile CI of tau*_BE
rule.transfer: apply tau*_BE unchanged to TEST entropy of specialist_prob_cal; never re-tuned on TEST
rule.must_be_computed_and_hashed_before: any metric is computed on the v2 E3 TEST responses
